description:
What is This Part?
These are the rubber covers that go over the metal foot plates on the Accelerator, clutch and brake pedals
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Cover, Clutch
Qty 1 – Cover, Brake
Qty 1 – Cover, Accelerator
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
